title: Irish Migration Data
tagline: Official data on migration and citizenship in Ireland, and research about it, grouped by where it comes from.

sources.title: Parliamentary questions
sources.summary: Questions to Ministers and their answers, 2016–2026, and the statistics in the spreadsheets attached to them.
